# BROSKI

> Crunchy dog biscuits from Nangloi, West Delhi – 110041. Treats for your best bro.

## Brand Overview
BROSKI is a dog biscuit brand founded by Lakshay, based in Nangloi, West Delhi – 110041. We make crunchy dog biscuits for training and treat time.

- **Founder:** Lakshay
- **Location:** Nangloi, West Delhi – 110041
- **MSME / Udyam:** UDYAM-DL-11-0177908
- **Website:** https://broskipetfood.com/
- **Contact:** WhatsApp or email support@broskipetfood.com

## Products
- **Bro Bites – Classic Crunch:** Yellow pack, 400 g pouch, MRP ₹149 (₹0.37/g). Crunchy bone-shaped dog biscuits.
- **Bro Mix – Happy Mix:** White pack, 400 g pouch, MRP ₹179 (₹0.45/g). Crunchy dog biscuits.
- **Bro Combo:** 1 Bro Bites – Classic Crunch + 1 Bro Mix – Happy Mix (2 × 400 g), ₹295 (10% off).
- **Free Taste Pack:** Complimentary 50 g taste pack.

## Ingredients
- **Bro Bites – Classic Crunch:** Real Chicken, Egg Powder, Whole Wheat Flour, Rice Flour, Corn Flour, Fish Oil, Vegetable Oil, Sodium Bicarbonate, Flavours, Permitted Colours.
- **Bro Mix – Happy Mix:** Chicken Powder, Egg Powder, Whole Wheat Flour, Rice Flour, Corn Flour, Fish Oil, Vegetable Oil, Sodium Bicarbonate, Flavours, Colour.
- Both products contain chicken and egg.

## Use & Feeding
- A treat, not a meal. Break into smaller pieces for smaller dogs.
- Always keep fresh water nearby.

## Shelf Life
- Best before 12 months from packing (see pack for details).

## Ordering & Delivery
- Order directly on WhatsApp (or email support@broskipetfood.com).
- Payment and delivery details are confirmed in chat.
- Delivery in West Delhi: free within 5 km of Nangloi on orders from ₹295; otherwise applicable delivery charges apply (shown at checkout).

## Pet Shops & Wholesale
- Pet shops and veterinary clinics can contact us directly on WhatsApp for trade terms.
